_comment: Trading mandate configuration — authorization constraints for the automated worker.
_usage: cp config/mandate.example.json config/mandate.json && edit to taste. If absent, a permissive mandate is used (all symbols, no caps).
_allowed_symbols_note: If non-empty, only these tickers may be bought. Empty [] allows all. SELL orders always bypass this list (you must be able to close a position).
_blocked_symbols_note: Hard deny-list, overrides allowed_symbols. Example: ["GME", "AMC"] would block meme stocks.
_max_notional_note: Max $ notional per single order. The RiskEngine applies its own cap (default 25% of equity), so this is a second, coarser gate. Null = no cap.
_max_daily_note: Max BUY orders per UTC day. SELL orders do not count. Null = no cap. Useful to throttle a runaway strategy.
_allowed_sides_note: Which order sides the worker may submit. ['buy', 'sell'] is the default. To freeze all new buys, set ['sell'].
